animations.name: order-received
animations.title: Order received
animations.usage: New order arrives (admin toast, staff queue, customer confirmation).

animations.name: order-accepted
animations.title: Order accepted
animations.usage: Staff accepts an order; customer sees confirmation.

animations.name: food-preparation
animations.title: Food preparation
animations.usage: Order is being prepared (loops while status = preparing).

animations.name: order-ready
animations.title: Order ready
animations.usage: Order is ready to serve / collect.

animations.name: payment-success
animations.title: Payment success
animations.usage: Payment confirmed at checkout (customer) or POS (staff).

animations.name: empty-orders
animations.title: Empty order list
animations.usage: No orders yet. Calm idle loop; never draws attention.

animations.name: empty-reservations
animations.title: Empty reservation list
animations.usage: No bookings for the selected date. Calm idle loop.

animations.name: loading-processing
animations.title: Loading / processing
animations.usage: Indeterminate work longer than ~1 s (sync, report generation). Use skeletons for content loading.

animations.name: restaurant-onboarding
animations.title: Restaurant onboarding
animations.usage: Welcome / first-run setup hero. Plays once.
